idea_queries: creepy what would you do short
seed_ideas: The babysitter hears footsteps upstairs but the kids are asleep downstairs
Your car breaks down on an empty road and someone knocks on the window
The night guard notices one camera shows a room that does not exist
horror.tone: slow-burn creepy horror. Short, tense sentences. Second person ("you"). Build dread line by line, one unsettling detail at a time. End on a chilling cliffhanger.
horror.visual_hint: dark, shadowy, empty, abandoned places at night (e.g. "dark hallway", "foggy forest night", "flickering light")
horror.image_style: dark horror film still, eerie, moody low-key lighting, fog, desaturated, 35mm film grain, photorealistic

idea_queries: when you try to adult shorts
seed_ideas: Trying to look busy when the boss walks past
Your mom asks you to find something she hid in the house
Your dog judging every life choice you make
comedy.tone: upbeat, playful comedy. Relatable everyday situations, quick punchlines, exaggeration, a twist on the last line. Clean humor, no insults.
comedy.cta: Tag a friend who does this.
comedy.visual_hint: bright, funny, expressive everyday moments (e.g. "funny dog", "surprised face", "office fail", "cat jumping")
comedy.image_style: bright funny photo, vivid colours, expressive, sunny, sharp focus, photorealistic

seed_ideas: What would happen if the Moon disappeared tonight
Why you can never see your own blind spot
How a teaspoon of a neutron star would weigh billions of tons
science.tone: curious, clear, mind-blowing science explainer. Every line one true, simple fact, building to a surprising final fact. No made-up facts; if unsure keep it general.
science.cta: Follow for one fact a day.
science.visual_hint: space, laboratory, nature, microscope, technology footage (e.g. "galaxy", "lab experiment", "earth from space")
science.image_style: scientific documentary still, crisp, clean lighting, awe-inspiring, National Geographic style, photorealistic

seed_ideas: Nobody is coming to save you, and that is good news
The version of you in five years is watching right now
Discipline is choosing what you want most over what you want now
motivation.tone: powerful, intense motivational speech. Short punchy lines, direct "you", rising energy, one memorable final line.
motivation.cta: Follow if you are not giving up.
motivation.visual_hint: cinematic training, running, mountains, sunrise, city at dawn (e.g. "man running sunrise", "boxing training", "mountain summit")
motivation.image_style: epic cinematic photo, golden hour, dramatic light, high contrast, heroic, photorealistic

mystery.niche: unsolved mysteries and strange true stories shorts
seed_ideas: A ship found sailing perfectly with no one on board
A town where every clock stopped at the same minute
A radio signal from space that was never heard again
mystery.tone: intriguing documentary-style mystery. Calm, curious narrator, clues revealed one by one, ending with an open question for the viewer. Say "reportedly" for anything not proven.
mystery.visual_hint: fog, old documents, abandoned places, ocean, night sky, old photographs (e.g. "foggy ocean ship", "old map", "abandoned town")
mystery.image_style: mysterious documentary still, fog, muted colours, dim light, film grain, photorealistic
